description: This file implements an Active Record pattern for database interaction within the ADOdb PHP library. It defines classes and functions for managing database records, their relations, and database schema details, providing an abstraction for CRUD operations and relationships.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection with a collection of active table schemas.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Stores metadata about a database table, including fields and keys, and relationships.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Main class implementing Active Record pattern for CRUD operations and managing relations. Supports dynamic property access and schema updates.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with an internal registry for active schemas.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an active record object, setting up table info and database adapter.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a database record matching a where condition into the object.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts or updates the current record in the database.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database table.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the existing record in the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Returns an array of active record objects matching the where condition.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the current record from the database to refresh state.

methods.name: hasMany
methods.description: Defines a one-to-many relationship from this record.

methods.name: belongsTo
methods.description: Defines a many-to-one relationship from this record.

methods.name: LoadRelations
methods.description: Lazily loads related records based on relationship definitions.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Updates or loads table metadata, including schema caching.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns the associated database connection object.

methods.name: TableInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the associated table.

methods.name: nameQuoter
methods.description: Quotes table and column names according to database settings.
